outgoing.name: Aquarium
outgoing.excerpt: Zebra sharks do well in captivity, and a number of aquariums around the world have them on display.

outgoing.name: Indian Ocean
outgoing.excerpt: The zebra shark is found in the tropical Western Pacific Ocean and Indian Ocean at depths of about 5 to 30 meters.
